_comment: Shared build-time settings, read by render.js and exposed to every template as {{site.*}}. Add keys; do not rename existing ones without telling the other team. Values marked ASSUMED are awaiting the user.

repo._note: ASSUMED default. Used by the card 'View on Github' link (Catalog team) and the About page GitHub link (Shell team). For the demo the build may override with --repo-url/--repo-branch.

intro._note: Shell team fills this (B-06). Wording needs user approval.
